name: hud_ui_net_exit_resume_widget_on_hide_preview
description: HudUiNetExitPanel_ResumeWidget::OnHidePreview releases preview input capture, saves and clears focus when appropriate, and hides the base ZRD preview.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x41bfa0 validates that an active preview pops the bind-map context, checks zInp::GetJoystickOption, restores reticle mode 1 and saves/clears input focus only when joystick is disabled, clears previewInputCaptureActive, and always calls HudUiZrdWidget::HidePreview.

The native smoke patches the input, reticle, GetInputFocus, SetInputFocus, and HidePreview calls; it verifies the first joystick-disabled hide, verifies an already-inactive repeat only calls HidePreview, and verifies the joystick-enabled branch skips reticle/focus work while still releasing preview capture.
